title: Computing the Nonnegative Low-Rank Leading Eigenmatrix and its Applications to Markov Grids and Metzler Operators
summary: We consider in this paper the problem of computing a nonnegative low-rank approximation of the rightmost eigenpair of a linear matrix-valued real operator. We propose an algorithm based on the time integration of a suitable differential system, whose solution is parametrized according to a nonnegative factorization.
